commits_info.message:
2.17.7 release (previous 2.17.6) + release notes updated by CI build 3349

[ci skip-release]

Merge pull request #1324 from dmitry-timofeev/then_throw_cleanups

Improved stubbing internals and test coverage
Add a comment explaining the test scenarios.
Removed tests for coverage that is already covered

Renamed test class and add one more case

This way we preserve the current functionality in unit tests

Add a return statement so that it’s clear that the following code won’t be executed.

It also prevents false-positives of static-analysis tools (e.g., IDEA).

Add a couple of tests of ThrowsException:

- Verify a custom exception breaking Throwable#fillInStackTrace contract
  doesn't break ThrowableAnswer (see #866).
- Verify a ThrowsException answer always answers with the same throwable,
  if it is well-behaved.

Kept some functionality for backwards compatibility

Let's keep the assignment for compatibility. There is no strong reason to remove it. We have test coverage for this complexity and it is cheap.

Reverted unnecessary changes

Replaced TODO with a comment following conversation in PR #1324

Clarify that ThrowsException always returns the same throwable.

The previous `#answer` implementation might give an illusion that
`Throwable#fillInStackTrace` produces a new throwable, but that
is not correct — it always returns `this`.

Also, replace a possible NPE with a descriptive IllegalStateException.

Fixes #1323: Clarify intentions in BaseStubbing:

Replace an obsolete TODO with a clarifying comment
and add some tests covering related test cases.

Also, extract the code aborting the ongoing stubbing
in a separate method that always throws.
Use return `abortNullExceptionType` so that
static-analysis tools (e.g., IDEA) yield no false-positives.

Apply errorprone to all java projects (#1358)

* apply errorprone plugin to all projects

* add @SuppressWarnings in subprojects

* apply errorprone to all java projects

* configure errorprone version

* move errorprone dependency to dependencies.gradle and use buildscript section to add errorprone plugin to the buildscript classpath

* make script more consistent

* using sourceCompatibility=1.8 for test projects and testng project

Add JDK 10 and 11 to the build matrix (#1356)

* Add JDK 10 and 11 to the build matrix

* Remove jdk properties from build matrix

* Update jacoco to 0.8.1 for java 10 compatibility

* Update location of TestNG Javadoc

* Update version of JDK 10 installation

* Upgrade Kotlin JVM version to fix compilation on JDK 10/11

* Use Gradle nightly version 4.8

* Revert back to Gradle 4.6 and allow failures on JDK 11

* Add back checksum sha256

Update shipkit to v2.0.15 (#1357)

- we actually got rid of unnecessary hits to GitHub REST API during non-release builds
